correctness.rationale: The signed monomial Jacobian has \(g=\gcd(M,k)\) coordinate cycles. Exactly \(q=k/g\) negative double wrap factors occur in each; left-branch insertions in gaps indexed by number of preceding right visits assign one factor 2 to a chosen residue. Every residue has a gap since \(k\ge g\); all weak compositions arise from actual branch words and original full-text coding. Stars and bars yields the complete per-spectrum frequency; different exponent multisets are separated by eigenvalue moduli; balanced and extreme compositions give sharp contrasts. Exact independent 2510 return characteristic-polynomial computations checked 180 small-parameter distributions. Unbounded result derives from the proof, not tests.

value.rationale: Periodic eigenvalue spectra describe the distribution of expansion across the dimensions in a map developed to model vortex dynamics; previous work counted only real versus nonreal types and established nonuniform Lyapunov behavior. A complete partition-indexed census, exact per-spectrum point frequencies and attained optimal anisotropy bounds expose the full finite-period expansion diversity for every dimension and visit count, supplying a motivated, naturally complete dynamical invariant rather than an arbitrary isolated finite computation.
